command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmds=@('display ip routing-table 150.0.0.1','display ip routing-table 160.0.0.1','display mpls lsp'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$n; foreach(`$c in `$cmds){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$x=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u; if(`$c -eq 'display mpls lsp'){ `$x.output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match '1001|1002|2001|2002' } } else { `$x.output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match '150.0.0.1/32|160.0.0.1/32' } } } }"
